name: Haus Central
beschreibung:
Centrally situated in pedestrian-friendly Serfaus, Haus Central provides well-kept rooms and apartments for relaxing holidays. Guests enjoy effortless access to all village amenities.

The Serfaus Dorfbahn underground, mountain cable cars, and ski slopes are merely footsteps away.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Central in Serfaus delights visitors with a prime village-center location and comfortable holiday lodgings.
